title: Smerdis
summary: Raleigh names Smerdis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Smerdis, a sonne of Cyrus the Great, in whom with his brother Cambyses the issue male of that race fayled. A word after his name, of how his brother Cambyses dealt with him, is a gap and was not filled. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter II, §. IV, sig. 395b
